Chapter 6

Authentication, Authorization, and Admission Control认证、授权与准入控制

The API server is the gateway to the Kubernetes cluster. Any human user, client (e.g., kubectl), cluster component, or service account will access the API server by making a RESTful API call via HTTPS. It is the central point for performing operations like creating a Pod or deleting a Service.

API server 是进入 Kubernetes 集群的网关。任何人类用户、客户端（例如 kubectl）、集群组件或 Service Account 都会通过 HTTPS 发起 RESTful API 调用来访问 API server。它是执行创建 Pod、删除 Service 等操作的中心枢纽。

In this chapter, we’ll focus on the security-specific aspects relevant to the API server. For a detailed discussion on the inner workings of the API server and use of the Kubernetes API, refer to Managing Kubernetes by Brendan Burns and Craig Tracey (O’Reilly, 2018).

本章聚焦于与 API server 相关的安全方面。关于 API server 内部工作机制以及 Kubernetes API 使用的详细讨论，参见 Brendan Burns 和 Craig Tracey 所著的《Managing Kubernetes》（O’Reilly，2018）。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives对应考试大纲目标

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective:

本章覆盖以下考试大纲目标：

  • Manage role-based access control (RBAC)管理基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）

Processing an API Request处理 API 请求

Figure 6-1 illustrates the stages a request goes through when a call is made to the API server. For reference, you can find more information in the Kubernetes documentation.

图 6-1 展示了向 API server 发起调用时，请求所经过的各个阶段。更多信息可参阅 Kubernetes 文档。

The first stage of request processing is authentication. Authentication validates the identity of the caller by inspecting the client certificates or bearer tokens. If the bearer token is associated with a service account, then it will be verified here.

请求处理的第一阶段是认证（authentication）。认证通过检查客户端证书或 bearer token 来验证调用者身份。如果 bearer token 与某个 Service Account 关联，也会在此处进行校验。

— PDF p.79 —

The second stage determines if the identity provided in the first stage can access the verb and HTTP path request. Therefore, stage two deals with authorization of the request, which is implemented with the standard Kubernetes RBAC model. Here, we ensure that the service account is allowed to list Pods or create a new Service object if that has been requested.

第二阶段判断第一阶段提供的身份是否能访问所请求的动词（verb）和 HTTP 路径。因此第二阶段处理请求的授权（authorization），它通过标准的 Kubernetes RBAC 模型实现。在此我们确保，如果请求列出 Pod 或创建新的 Service 对象，该 Service Account 确实被允许这样做。

The third stage of request processing deals with admission control. Admission control verifies whether the request is well formed or potentially needs to be modified before the request is processed. An admission control policy could, for example, ensure that the request for creating a Pod includes the definition of a specific label. If the request doesn’t define the label, then it is rejected.

请求处理的第三阶段处理准入控制（admission control）。准入控制在请求被处理之前验证其格式是否正确，或是否需要被修改。例如，一条准入控制策略可以确保创建 Pod 的请求包含某个特定标签的定义；如果请求没有定义该标签，就会被拒绝。

Authentication with kubectl使用 kubectl 进行认证

Developers interact with the Kubernetes API by running the kubectl command-line tool. Whenever you execute a command with kubectl, the underlying HTTPS call to the API server needs to authenticate.

开发者通过运行 kubectl 命令行工具与 Kubernetes API 交互。每当你用 kubectl 执行命令时，底层对 API server 的 HTTPS 调用都需要完成认证。

The KubeconfigKubeconfig 文件

Credentials for the use of kubectl are stored in the file $HOME/.kube/config, also known as the kubeconfig file. The kubeconfig file defines the API server endpoints of the clusters we want to interact with, as well as a list of users registered with the cluster, including their credentials in the form of client certificates. The mapping between a cluster and user for a given namespace is called a context. kubectl uses the currently selected context to know which cluster to talk to and which credentials to use.

使用 kubectl 的凭证保存在 $HOME/.kube/config 文件中，也就是 kubeconfig 文件。kubeconfig 文件定义了我们想要交互的集群的 API server 端点，以及在集群中注册的用户列表（包括以客户端证书形式呈现的凭证）。集群、用户在给定命名空间下的映射称为 context（上下文）。kubectl 使用当前选中的 context 来知道该与哪个集群通信、使用哪组凭证。

— PDF p.80 —
Merging multiple kubeconfig files合并多个 kubeconfig 文件

You can point the environment variable KUBECONFIG to a set of kubeconfig files. At runtime, kubectl will merge the contents of the set of defined kubeconfig files and use them. By default, KUBECONFIG is not set and falls back to $HOME/.kube/config.

你可以让环境变量 KUBECONFIG 指向一组 kubeconfig 文件。运行时，kubectl 会合并这些已定义 kubeconfig 文件的内容并使用。默认情况下 KUBECONFIG 未设置，回退使用 $HOME/.kube/config。

Example 6-1 shows a kubeconfig file. Be aware that file paths assigned in the example are user-specific and may differ in your own environment. You can find a detailed description of all configurable attributes in the config resource type API documentation.

例 6-1 展示了一个 kubeconfig 文件。请注意示例中给出的文件路径是特定于用户的，在你自己的环境中可能不同。所有可配置属性的详细描述见 config 资源类型的 API 文档。

Example 6-1. A kubeconfig file

例 6-1. 一个 kubeconfig 文件

apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
clusters:
- cluster:
    certificate-authority: /Users/bmuschko/.minikube/ca.crt
    extensions:
    - extension:
        last-update: Mon, 09 Oct 2023 07:33:01 MDT
        provider: minikube.sigs.k8s.io
        version: v1.30.1
      name: cluster_info
    server: https://127.0.0.1:63709
  name: minikube
contexts:
- context:
    cluster: minikube
    user: bmuschko
  name: bmuschko
- context:
    cluster: minikube
    extensions:
    - extension:
        last-update: Mon, 09 Oct 2023 07:33:01 MDT
        provider: minikube.sigs.k8s.io
        version: v1.30.1
      name: context_info
    namespace: default
    user: minikube
  name: minikube
current-context: minikube
preferences: {}
users:
- name: bmuschko
  user:
    client-key-data: <REDACTED>
- name: minikube
— PDF p.81 —
  user:
    client-certificate: /Users/bmuschko/.minikube/profiles/minikube/client.crt
    client-key: /Users/bmuschko/.minikube/profiles/minikube/client.key
  • A list of referential names to clusters and their API server endpoints集群及其 API server 端点的引用名称列表
  • A list of referential names to contexts (a combination of cluster and user)context 的引用名称列表（集群与用户的组合）
  • The currently selected context当前选中的 context
  • A list of referential names to users and their credentials用户及其凭证的引用名称列表

User management is handled by the cluster administrator. The administrator creates a user representing the developer and hands the relevant information (username and credentials) to the human wanting to interact with the cluster via kubectl. Alternatively, it is also possible to integrate with external identity providers for authentication purposes, e.g., via OpenID Connect.

用户管理由集群管理员负责。管理员创建一个代表开发者的用户，并把相关信息（用户名和凭证）交给希望通过 kubectl 与集群交互的人。另外，也可以集成外部身份提供方进行认证，例如通过 OpenID Connect。

Creating a new user manually consists of multiple steps, as described in the Kubernetes documentation. The developer would then add the user to the kubeconfig file on the machine intended to interact with the cluster.

手动创建一个新用户包含多个步骤，如 Kubernetes 文档所述。开发者随后会把该用户添加到用于与集群交互的机器上的 kubeconfig 文件中。

Managing Kubeconfig Using kubectl用 kubectl 管理 kubeconfig

You do not have to manually edit the kubeconfig file(s) to change or add configuration. kubectl provides commands for reading and modifying its contents. The following commands provide an overview. You can find additional examples for commands in the kubectl cheat sheet.

你不必手动编辑 kubeconfig 文件来修改或添加配置。kubectl 提供了读取和修改其内容的命令。下面的命令给出一个概览。更多命令示例见 kubectl 速查表（cheat sheet）。

To view the merged contents of the kubeconfig file(s), run the following command:

要查看 kubeconfig 文件合并后的内容，运行下面的命令：

$ kubectl config view
apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
clusters:
...

To render the currently selected context, use the current-context subcommand. The context named minikube is the active one:

要显示当前选中的 context，使用 current-context 子命令。名为 minikube 的 context 是当前激活的：

$ kubectl config current-context
minikube

To change the context, provide the name with the use-context subcommand. Here, we are switching to the context bmuschko:

要切换 context，使用 use-context 子命令并提供名称。这里我们切换到 context bmuschko：

$ kubectl config use-context bmuschko
Switched to context "bmuschko".
— PDF p.82 —

To register a user with the kubeconfig file(s), use the set-credentials subcommand. We are choosing to assign the username myuser and point to the client certificate by providing the corresponding CLI flags:

要在 kubeconfig 文件中注册一个用户，使用 set-credentials 子命令。这里我们选择分配用户名 myuser，并通过提供相应的 CLI 标志指向客户端证书：

$ kubectl config set-credentials myuser \
  --client-key=myuser.key --client-certificate=myuser.crt \
  --embed-certs=true

For the exam, familiarize yourself with the kubectl config command. Every task in the exam will require you to work with a specific context and/or namespace.

考试时请熟悉 kubectl config 命令。考试中的每个任务都要求你在特定的 context 和/或 namespace 中操作。

Authorization with Role-Based Access Control基于角色的访问控制授权

We’ve learned that the API server will try to authenticate any request sent using kubectl by verifying the provided credentials. An authenticated request will then need to be checked against the permissions assigned to the requestor. The authorization phase of the API processing workflow checks if the operation is permitted against the requested API resource.

我们已经了解，API server 会通过验证所提供的凭证来对任何使用 kubectl 发送的请求进行认证。通过认证的请求还需要对照分配给请求者的权限进行检查。API 处理工作流的授权阶段会检查所请求的操作是否针对所请求的 API 资源被允许。

In Kubernetes, those permissions can be controlled using role-based access control (RBAC). In a nutshell, RBAC defines policies for users, groups, and service accounts by allowing or disallowing access to manage API resources. Enabling and configuring RBAC is mandatory for any organization with an emphasis on security.

在 Kubernetes 中，这些权限可以通过基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）来控制。简而言之，RBAC 通过允许或拒绝访问、管理 API 资源，为用户、用户组和 Service Account 定义策略。对于任何重视安全的组织，启用并配置 RBAC 都是必须的。

Setting permissions is the responsibility of a cluster administrator. The following sections briefly cover the effects of RBAC on requests from users and service accounts.

设置权限是集群管理员的职责。接下来的小节简要介绍 RBAC 对来自用户和 Service Account 请求的影响。

RBAC OverviewRBAC 概览

RBAC helps with implementing a variety of use cases:

RBAC 可帮助实现多种用例：

  • Establishing a system for users with different roles to access a set of Kubernetes resources为具有不同角色的用户建立访问一组 Kubernetes 资源的系统
  • Controlling processes (associated with a service account) running in a Pod and performing operations against the Kubernetes API控制在 Pod 中运行、并对 Kubernetes API 执行操作的进程（与 Service Account 关联）
  • Limiting the visibility of certain resources per namespace按命名空间限制某些资源的可见性

RBAC consists of three key building blocks, as shown in Figure 6-2. Together, they connect API primitives and their allowed operations to the subject, which is a user, a group, or a service account.

RBAC 由三个关键构建块组成，如图 6-2 所示。它们共同把 API 原语及其允许的操作连接到 subject（主体），即用户、用户组或 Service Account。

— PDF p.83 —

Each block’s responsibilities are as follows:

每个构建块的职责如下：

  • Subject: The user or service account that wants to access a resourceSubject（主体）：想要访问资源的用户或 Service Account
  • Resource: The Kubernetes API resource type (e.g., a Deployment or node)Resource（资源）：Kubernetes API 资源类型（例如 Deployment 或 node）
  • Verb: The operation that can be executed on the resource (e.g., creating a Pod or deleting a Service)Verb（动词）：可以对资源执行的操作（例如创建 Pod 或删除 Service）

When you need to quickly determine which operations (verbs) are supported for a specific Kubernetes resource during the exam, kubectl api-resources -o wide is an invaluable command that displays all available API resources along with their supported verbs (like get, list, create, update, patch, watch, delete).

考试时当你需要快速判断某个 Kubernetes 资源支持哪些操作（动词）时，kubectl api-resources -o wide 是一条非常有用的命令，它会显示所有可用 API 资源及其支持的动词（如 get、list、create、update、patch、watch、delete）。

Understanding RBAC API Primitives理解 RBAC API 原语

With these key concepts in mind, let’s look at the Kubernetes API primitives that implement the RBAC functionality:

理解这些关键概念后，我们来看看实现 RBAC 功能的 Kubernetes API 原语：

  • Role: The Role API primitive declares which of the API resources and their operations this rule should operate on in a specific namespace. For example, you may want to say “allow listing and deleting of Pods,” or you may express “allow watching the logs of Pods,” or even both with the same Role. Any operation that is not spelled out explicitly is disallowed as soon as it is bound to the subject.Role：Role API 原语声明该规则在特定命名空间中应作用于哪些 API 资源及其操作。例如，你可以说“允许列出和删除 Pod”，或者表达“允许 watch Pod 的日志”，甚至用同一个 Role 同时表达两者。任何未显式列出的操作，一旦绑定到主体就被默认禁止。
  • RoleBinding: The RoleBinding API primitive binds the Role object to the subject(s) in a specific namespace. It is the glue for making the rules active. For example, you may want to say “bind the Role that permits updating Services to the user John Doe.”RoleBinding：RoleBinding API 原语在特定命名空间中把 Role 对象绑定到一个或多个主体。它是让规则生效的粘合剂。例如，你可以说“把允许更新 Service 的 Role 绑定到用户 John Doe”。

Figure 6-3 shows the relationship between the involved API primitives. Keep in mind that the image renders only a selected list of API resource types and operations.

图 6-3 展示了相关 API 原语之间的关系。请记住，图中只渲染了部分 API 资源类型和操作列表。

— PDF p.84 —

The following sections demonstrate the namespace-wide usage of Roles and RoleBindings, but the same operations and attributes apply to cluster-wide Roles and RoleBindings, discussed in “Namespace-Wide and Cluster-Wide RBAC” on page 68.

接下来的小节演示 Role 和 RoleBinding 在命名空间范围内的用法，但相同的操作和属性也适用于集群范围的 Role 和 RoleBinding，见第 68 页“Namespace-Wide and Cluster-Wide RBAC”。

Default User-Facing Roles默认的面向用户的 Role

Kubernetes defines a set of default Roles. You can assign them to a subject via a RoleBinding or define your own custom Roles depending on your needs. Table 6-1 describes the default user-facing Roles.

Kubernetes 定义了一组默认 Role。你可以通过 RoleBinding 把它们分配给主体，也可以根据需要定义自己的自定义 Role。表 6-1 描述了默认的面向用户的 Role。

Table 6-1. Default user-facing Roles

表 6-1. 默认的面向用户的 Role

Default ClusterRoleDescription
cluster-adminAllows read and write access to resources across all namespaces.
cluster-admin允许对所有命名空间中的资源进行读写访问。
adminAllows read and write access to resources in namespace including Roles and RoleBindings.
admin允许对命名空间内的资源（包括 Role 和 RoleBinding）进行读写访问。
editAllows read and write access to resources in namespace except Roles and RoleBindings. Provides access to Secrets.
edit允许对命名空间内除 Role 和 RoleBinding 之外的资源进行读写访问。可访问 Secret。
viewAllows read-only access to resources in namespace except Roles, RoleBindings, and Secrets.
view允许对命名空间内除 Role、RoleBinding 和 Secret 之外的资源进行只读访问。

To define new Roles and RoleBindings, you will have to use a context that allows for creating or modifying them, that is, cluster-admin or admin.

要定义新的 Role 和 RoleBinding，你必须使用允许创建或修改它们的 context，即 cluster-admin 或 admin。

Creating Roles创建 Role

Roles can be created imperatively with the create role command. The most important options for the command are --verb for defining the verbs, aka operations, and --resource for declaring a list of API resources (core primitives as well as CRDs). The following command creates a new Role for the resources Pod, Deployment, and Service with the verbs list, get, and watch:

Role 可以通过 create role 命令以命令式方式创建。该命令最重要的选项是 --verb（用于定义动词，即操作）和 --resource（用于声明 API 资源列表，包括核心原语和 CRD）。下面的命令为 Pod、Deployment 和 Service 资源创建一个新 Role，动词为 list、get 和 watch：

— PDF p.85 —
$ kubectl create role read-only --verb=list,get,watch \
  --resource=pods,deployments,services
role.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/read-only created

Declaring multiple verbs and resources for a single imperative create role command can be declared as a comma-separated list for the corresponding command-line option or as multiple arguments. For example, --verb=list,get,watch and --verb=list --verb=get --verb=watch carry the same instructions. You also can use the wildcard * to refer to all verbs or resources.

在单条命令式 create role 命令中声明多个动词和资源时，可以用逗号分隔列表作为对应命令行选项的值，也可以写成多个参数。例如，--verb=list,get,watch 与 --verb=list --verb=get --verb=watch 表达相同的含义。你也可以使用通配符 * 表示所有动词或所有资源。

The command-line option --resource-name spells out one or many object names that the policy rules should apply to. A name of a Pod could be nginx and listed here with its name. Providing a list of resource names is optional. If no names have been provided, then the provided rules apply to all objects of a resource type.

命令行选项 --resource-name 指定策略规则应作用于的一个或多个对象名称。例如某个 Pod 的名字可以是 nginx，并在这里以名称列出。提供资源名称列表是可选的；如果不提供名称，所给规则将作用于该资源类型的所有对象。

The declarative approach can become a little lengthy. As you can see in Example 6-2, the section rules lists the resources and verbs. Resources with an API group, like Deployments that use the API version apps/v1, need to explicitly declare it under the attribute apiGroups. All other resources (e.g., Pods and Services) simply use an empty string, as their API version doesn’t contain a group. Be aware that the imperative command for creating a Role automatically determines the API group.

声明式方式可能会稍显冗长。如例 6-2 所示，rules 部分列出了资源和动词。带有 API 组的资源（例如使用 apps/v1 API 版本的 Deployment）需要在 apiGroups 属性下显式声明该组。其他资源（例如 Pod 和 Service）直接使用空字符串，因为它们的 API 版本不包含组。请注意，命令式创建 Role 的命令会自动判断 API 组。

Example 6-2. A YAML manifest defining a Role

例 6-2. 定义 Role 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: read-only
rules:
- apiGroups:
  - ""
  resources:
  - pods
  - services
  verbs:
  - list
  - get
  - watch
- apiGroups:
  - apps
  resources:
  - deployments
  verbs:
  - list
  - get
  - watch
— PDF p.86 —

Any resource that belongs to an API group needs to be listed as an explicit rule in addition to the API resources that do not belong to an API group.

属于某个 API 组的任何资源，除了不属于 API 组的 API 资源之外，都需要作为一条显式规则列出。

Listing Roles列出 Role

Once the Role has been created, its object can be listed. The list of Roles renders only the name and the creation timestamp. Each of the listed roles does not give away any of its details:

Role 创建后，可以列出其对象。Role 列表只显示名称和创建时间戳；每个列出的 Role 不会透露任何细节：

$ kubectl get roles
NAME        CREATED AT
read-only   2021-06-23T19:46:48Z

Rendering Role Details查看 Role 详情

You can inspect the details of a Role using the describe command. The output renders a table that maps a resource to its permitted verbs:

可以使用 describe 命令查看 Role 的详情。输出会以表格形式把资源映射到其被允许的动词：

$ kubectl describe role read-only
Name:         read-only
Labels:       <none>
Annotations:  <none>
PolicyRule:
  Resources         Non-Resource URLs  Resource Names  Verbs
  ---------         -----------------  --------------  -----
  pods              []                 []              [list get watch]
  services          []                 []              [list get watch]
  deployments.apps  []                 []              [list get watch]

This cluster has no resources created, so the list of resource names in the following console output is currently empty.

该集群中没有创建任何资源，因此下面控制台输出中的资源名称列表目前为空。

Creating RoleBindings创建 RoleBinding

The imperative command to create a RoleBinding object is create rolebinding. To bind a Role to the RoleBinding, use the --role command-line option. The subject type can be assigned by declaring the options --user, --group, or --serviceaccount. The following command creates the RoleBinding with the name read-only-binding to the user called bmuschko:

创建 RoleBinding 对象的命令式命令是 create rolebinding。要把 Role 绑定到 RoleBinding，使用 --role 命令行选项。主体类型可以通过声明 --user、--group 或 --serviceaccount 选项来指定。下面的命令创建名为 read-only-binding 的 RoleBinding，绑定到用户 bmuschko：

$ kubectl create rolebinding read-only-binding --role=read-only --user=bmuschko
rolebinding.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/read-only-binding created

Example 6-3 shows a YAML manifest representing the RoleBinding. You can see from the structure that a role can be mapped to one or many subjects. The data type is an array indicated by the dash character under the attribute subjects. At this time, only the user bmuschko has been assigned.

例 6-3 展示了表示该 RoleBinding 的 YAML manifest。从结构可以看出，一个 role 可以映射到一个或多个主体。subjects 属性下由短横线表示的数据类型是数组。此时只分配了用户 bmuschko。

— PDF p.87 —

Example 6-3. A YAML manifest defining a RoleBinding

例 6-3. 定义 RoleBinding 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: read-only-binding
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: read-only
subjects:
- apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: User
  name: bmuschko

Listing RoleBindings列出 RoleBinding

The most important information the list of RoleBindings displays is the associated Role. The following command shows that the RoleBinding read-only-binding has been mapped to the Role read-only:

RoleBinding 列表显示的最重要信息是关联的 Role。下面的命令显示 RoleBinding read-only-binding 已映射到 Role read-only：

$ kubectl get rolebindings
NAME                ROLE             AGE
read-only-binding   Role/read-only   24h

The output does not provide an indication of the subjects. You will need to render the details of the object for more information, as described in the next section.

该输出不会显示主体信息。要了解更多内容，需要查看对象详情，如下一节所述。

Rendering RoleBinding Details查看 RoleBinding 详情

RoleBindings can be inspected using the describe command. The output renders a table of subjects and the assigned role. The following example renders the descriptive representation of the RoleBinding named read-only-binding:

可以使用 describe 命令查看 RoleBinding。输出会以表格形式展示主体及其被分配的 role。下面的例子展示了名为 read-only-binding 的 RoleBinding 的描述性表示：

$ kubectl describe rolebinding read-only-binding
Name:         read-only-binding
Labels:       <none>
Annotations:  <none>
Role:
  Kind:  Role
  Name:  read-only
Subjects:
  Kind  Name      Namespace
  ----  ----      ---------
  User  bmuschko
— PDF p.88 —

Seeing the RBAC Rules in Effect查看 RBAC 规则生效效果

Let’s see how Kubernetes enforces the RBAC rules for the scenario we’ve set up so far. First, we’ll create a new Deployment with the cluster-admin permissions. In minikube, those permissions are available to the context minikube by default:

下面看看 Kubernetes 在我们目前搭建的场景中如何强制执行 RBAC 规则。首先，我们用 cluster-admin 权限创建一个新的 Deployment。在 minikube 中，这些权限默认可用于 context minikube：

$ kubectl config current-context
minikube
$ kubectl create deployment myapp --image=nginx:1.25.2 --port=80 --replicas=2
deployment.apps/myapp created

Now, we’ll switch the context for the user bmuschko:

现在切换到用户 bmuschko 的 context：

$ kubectl config use-context bmuschko-context
Switched to context "bmuschko-context".

Remember that the user bmuschko is permitted to list Deployments. We’ll verify that by using the get deployments command:

请记住用户 bmuschko 被允许列出 Deployment。我们用 get deployments 命令来验证：

$ kubectl get deployments
NAME    READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
myapp   2/2     2            2           8s

The RBAC rules allow listing Deployments, Pods, and Services only. The following command tries to list the ReplicaSets, which results in an error:

RBAC 规则只允许列出 Deployment、Pod 和 Service。下面的命令尝试列出 ReplicaSet，结果会报错：

$ kubectl get replicasets
Error from server (Forbidden): replicasets.apps is forbidden: User "bmuschko" \
cannot list resource "replicasets" in API group "apps" in the namespace "default"

A similar behavior can be observed when trying to use verbs other than list, get, or watch. The following command tries to delete a Deployment:

当尝试使用 list、get、watch 之外的动词时，也会观察到类似行为。下面的命令尝试删除一个 Deployment：

$ kubectl delete deployment myapp
Error from server (Forbidden): deployments.apps "myapp" is forbidden: User \
"bmuschko" cannot delete resource "deployments" in API group "apps" in the \
namespace "default"

At any given time, you can check a user’s permissions with the auth can-i command. The command gives you the option to list all permissions or check a specific permission:

在任何时候，你都可以用 auth can-i 命令检查用户的权限。该命令既可以列出所有权限，也可以检查某一项具体权限：

$ kubectl auth can-i --list --as bmuschko
Resources          Non-Resource URLs   Resource Names   Verbs
...
pods               []                  []               [list get watch]
services           []                  []               [list get watch]
deployments.apps   []                  []               [list get watch]
$ kubectl auth can-i list pods --as bmuschko
yes
— PDF p.89 —

Namespace-Wide and Cluster-Wide RBAC命名空间范围与集群范围的 RBAC

Roles and RoleBindings apply to a particular namespace. You will have to specify the namespace when creating both objects. Sometimes, a set of Roles and RoleBindings needs to apply to multiple namespaces or even to the whole cluster. For a cluster-wide definition, Kubernetes offers the API resource types ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding. The configuration elements are effectively the same. The only difference is the value of the kind attribute:

Role 和 RoleBinding 作用于特定命名空间。创建这两个对象时必须指定 namespace。有时一组 Role 和 RoleBinding 需要作用于多个命名空间，甚至整个集群。对于集群范围的定义，Kubernetes 提供了 ClusterRole 和 ClusterRoleBinding 这两种 API 资源类型。配置元素实际上相同，唯一区别是 kind 属性的值：

  • To define a cluster-wide Role, use the imperative subcommand clusterrole or the kind ClusterRole in the YAML manifest.要定义集群范围的 Role，使用命令式子命令 clusterrole，或在 YAML manifest 中使用 kind ClusterRole。
  • To define a cluster-wide RoleBinding, use the imperative subcommand clusterrolebinding or the kind ClusterRoleBinding in the YAML manifest.要定义集群范围的 RoleBinding，使用命令式子命令 clusterrolebinding，或在 YAML manifest 中使用 kind ClusterRoleBinding。

ClusterRoles and ClusterRoleBindings not only set up cluster-wide permissions to a namespaced resource, but they can also be used to set up permissions for non-namespaced resources like CRDs and nodes.

ClusterRole 和 ClusterRoleBinding 不仅可以为命名空间资源设置集群范围的权限，还可以用于为 CRD、node 等非命名空间资源设置权限。

Aggregating RBAC Rules聚合 RBAC 规则

Existing ClusterRoles can be aggregated to avoid having to redefine a new, composed set of rules that likely leads to duplication of instructions. For example, say you wanted to combine a user-facing role with a custom Role. An aggregated ClusterRole can merge rules via label selection without having to copy-paste the existing rules into one.

可以对现有 ClusterRole 进行聚合，避免重新定义一套新的组合规则（那样容易导致指令重复）。例如，假设你想把一个面向用户的 role 与一个自定义 Role 组合起来。聚合式 ClusterRole 可以通过标签选择来合并规则，而无需把现有规则复制粘贴到一起。

Say we defined two ClusterRoles shown in Example 6-4 and Example 6-5. The ClusterRole list-pods allows for listing Pods and the ClusterRole delete-services allows for deleting Services.

假设我们定义了例 6-4 和例 6-5 所示的两个 ClusterRole。ClusterRole list-pods 允许列出 Pod，ClusterRole delete-services 允许删除 Service。

Example 6-4. A YAML manifest defining a ClusterRole for listing Pods

例 6-4. 定义用于列出 Pod 的 ClusterRole 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: list-pods
  namespace: rbac-example
  labels:
    rbac-pod-list: "true"
rules:
- apiGroups:
  - ""
  resources:
  - pods
  verbs:
  - list
— PDF p.90 —

Example 6-5. A YAML manifest defining a ClusterRole for deleting Services

例 6-5. 定义用于删除 Service 的 ClusterRole 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: delete-services
  namespace: rbac-example
  labels:
    rbac-service-delete: "true"
rules:
- apiGroups:
  - ""
  resources:
  - services
  verbs:
  - delete

To aggregate those rules, ClusterRoles can specify an aggregationRule. This attribute describes the label selection rules. Example 6-6 shows an aggregated ClusterRole defined by an array of matchLabels criteria. This ClusterRole does not add its own rules as indicated by rules: []; however, there’s no limiting factor that would disallow it.

要聚合这些规则，ClusterRole 可以指定 aggregationRule。该属性描述标签选择规则。例 6-6 展示了一个由 matchLabels 条件数组定义的聚合式 ClusterRole。如 rules: [] 所示，这个 ClusterRole 不添加自己的规则；但也没有任何限制因素阻止它这样做。

Example 6-6. A YAML manifest defining a ClusterRole with aggregated rules

例 6-6. 定义带有聚合规则的 ClusterRole 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: pods-services-aggregation-rules
  namespace: rbac-example
aggregationRule:
  clusterRoleSelectors:
  - matchLabels:
      rbac-pod-list: "true"
  - matchLabels:
      rbac-service-delete: "true"
rules: []

We can verify the proper aggregation behavior of the ClusterRole by describing the object. You can see in the following output that both ClusterRoles, list-pods and delete-services, have been taken into account:

我们可以通过 describe 该对象来验证 ClusterRole 的聚合行为是否正确。在下面的输出中可以看到，list-pods 和 delete-services 这两个 ClusterRole 都已被纳入考虑：

$ kubectl describe clusterroles pods-services-aggregation-rules -n rbac-example
Name:         pods-services-aggregation-rules
Labels:       <none>
Annotations:  <none>
PolicyRule:
— PDF p.91 —
Resources  Non-Resource URLs  Resource Names  Verbs
---------  -----------------  --------------  -----
services   []                 []              [delete]
pods       []                 []              [list]

For more information on ClusterRole label selection rules, see the official documentation. The page also explains how to aggregate the default user-facing ClusterRoles.

关于 ClusterRole 标签选择规则的更多信息，见官方文档。该页面还解释了如何聚合默认的面向用户的 ClusterRole。

Working with Service Accounts使用 Service Account

We’ve been using the kubectl executable to run operations against a Kubernetes cluster. Under the hood, its implementation calls the API server by making an HTTP call to the exposed endpoints. Some applications running inside of a Pod may have to communicate with the API server as well. For example, the application may ask for specific cluster node information or available namespaces.

我们一直使用 kubectl 可执行程序对 Kubernetes 集群执行操作。在底层，它的实现通过对暴露的端点发起 HTTP 调用来调用 API server。在 Pod 内部运行的一些应用可能也需要与 API server 通信。例如，应用可能会请求特定集群节点信息或可用命名空间。

Pods can use a service account to authenticate with the API server through an authentication token. A Kubernetes administrator assigns rules to a service account via RBAC to authorize access to specific resources and actions as illustrated in Figure 6-4.

Pod 可以使用 Service Account，通过认证令牌向 API server 认证。Kubernetes 管理员通过 RBAC 为 Service Account 分配规则，以授权对特定资源和操作的访问，如图 6-4 所示。

A Pod doesn’t necessarily need to be involved in the process. Other use cases call for leveraging a service account outside of a Kubernetes cluster. For example, you may want to communicate with the API server as part of a CI/CD pipeline automation step. The service account can provide the credentials to authenticate with the API server.

该过程不一定需要 Pod 参与。其他用例则要求在 Kubernetes 集群之外使用 Service Account。例如，你可能想在 CI/CD 流水线自动化步骤中与 API server 通信。Service Account 可以提供向 API server 认证的凭证。

The Default Service Account默认 Service Account

So far, we haven’t defined a service account for a Pod. If not assigned explicitly, a Pod uses the default service account, which has the same permissions as an unauthenticated user. This means that the Pod cannot view or modify the cluster state, or list or modify any of its resources. The default service account can, however, request basic cluster information via the assigned system:discovery Role.

到目前为止，我们还没有为 Pod 定义 Service Account。如果不显式分配，Pod 会使用默认 Service Account，其权限与未认证用户相同。这意味着 Pod 无法查看或修改集群状态，也无法列出或修改任何资源。不过，默认 Service Account 可以通过被分配的 system:discovery Role 请求基本的集群信息。

You can query for the available service accounts with the subcommand serviceaccounts. You should see only the default service account listed in the output:

可以使用子命令 serviceaccounts 查询可用的 Service Account。输出中应该只列出默认 Service Account：

— PDF p.92 —
$ kubectl get serviceaccounts
NAME      SECRETS   AGE
default   0         4d

While you can execute the kubectl operation to delete the default service account, Kubernetes will reinstantiate the service account immediately.

虽然你可以执行 kubectl 操作删除默认 Service Account，但 Kubernetes 会立即重新创建该 Service Account。

Creating a Service Account创建 Service Account

You can create a custom service account object using the imperative and declarative approach. This command creates a service account object with the name cicd-bot. The assumption here is to use the service account for calls to the API server made by a CI/CD pipeline:

你可以用命令式和声明式方式创建自定义 Service Account 对象。下面的命令创建名为 cicd-bot 的 Service Account 对象。这里的假设是：该 Service Account 用于 CI/CD 流水线对 API server 的调用：

$ kubectl create serviceaccount cicd-bot
serviceaccount/cicd-bot created

You can also represent the service account in the form of a manifest. In its simplest form, the definition assigns the kind ServiceAccount and a name, as shown in Example 6-7.

你也可以用 manifest 形式表示 Service Account。最简单的形式只需指定 kind 为 ServiceAccount 和一个名称，如例 6-7 所示。

Example 6-7. YAML manifest for a service account

例 6-7. Service Account 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: cicd-bot

You can set a couple of configuration options for a service account. For example, you may want to disable automounting of the authentication token when assigning the service account to a Pod. Although you will not need to understand those configuration options for the exam, it makes sense to dive deeper into security best practices by reading up on them in the Kubernetes documentation.

你可以为 Service Account 设置若干配置选项。例如，把 Service Account 分配给 Pod 时，你可能想禁用认证令牌的自动挂载。虽然考试不要求你理解这些配置选项，但通过 Kubernetes 文档深入学习安全最佳实践是有意义的。

Setting Permissions for a Service Account为 Service Account 设置权限

It’s important to limit the permissions to only the service accounts that are necessary for the application to function. The next sections will explain how we will achieve this to minimize the potential attack service.

重要的是把权限限制为应用运行所必需的那些 Service Account。接下来的小节将解释如何做到这一点，以尽量缩小潜在攻击面。

For this scenario to work, you’ll need to create a ServiceAccount object and assign it to the Pod. Service accounts can be tied in with RBAC and assigned a Role and RoleBinding to define which operations they should be allowed to perform.

要让该场景运转起来，你需要创建一个 ServiceAccount 对象并把它分配给 Pod。Service Account 可以与 RBAC 关联，分配 Role 和 RoleBinding 以定义它们被允许执行哪些操作。

Binding the service account to a Pod把 Service Account 绑定到 Pod

As a starting point, we will set up a Pod that lists all Pods and Deployments in the namespace k97 by calling the Kubernetes API. The call is made as part of an infinite loop every ten seconds. The response from the API call will be written to standard output accessible via the Pod’s logs.

作为起点，我们将搭建一个 Pod，通过调用 Kubernetes API 列出命名空间 k97 中的所有 Pod 和 Deployment。该调用作为一个每十秒执行一次的无限循环的一部分。API 调用的响应会写入标准输出，可以通过 Pod 日志访问。

— PDF p.93 —
Accessing the API server endpoint访问 API server 端点

Accessing the Kubernetes API from a Pod is straightforward. Instead of using the IP address and port for the API server Pod, you can simply refer to a Service named kubernetes.default.svc instead. This special Service lives in the default namespace and is stood up by the cluster automatically.

从 Pod 访问 Kubernetes API 非常直接。你不需要使用 API server Pod 的 IP 地址和端口，而是可以直接引用一个名为 kubernetes.default.svc 的 Service。这个特殊的 Service 位于 default 命名空间，由集群自动搭建。

To authenticate against the API server, we’ll send a bearer token associated with the service account used by the Pod. The default behavior of a service account is to automount API credentials on the path /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token. We’ll simply get the contents of the file using the cat command-line tool and send them along as a header for the HTTP request. Example 6-8 defines the namespace, the service account, and the Pod in a single YAML manifest file: setup.yaml.

为了向 API server 认证，我们将发送与 Pod 所使用的 Service Account 关联的 bearer token。Service Account 的默认行为是把 API 凭证自动挂载到路径 /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token。我们只需用 cat 命令行工具取得该文件内容，并把它作为 HTTP 请求的头发送。例 6-8 在单个 YAML manifest 文件 setup.yaml 中定义了命名空间、Service Account 和 Pod。

Example 6-8. YAML manifest for assigning a service account to a Pod

例 6-8. 把 Service Account 分配给 Pod 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: k97
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: sa-api
  namespace: k97
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: list-objects
  namespace: k97
spec:
  serviceAccountName: sa-api
  containers:
  - name: pods
    image: alpine/curl:3.14
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'while true; do curl -s -k -m 5 -H \
              "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/ \
              serviceaccount/token)" https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster. \
              local/api/v1/namespaces/k97/pods; sleep 10; done']
  - name: deployments
    image: alpine/curl:3.14
    command: ['sh', '-c', 'while true; do curl -s -k -m 5 -H \
— PDF p.94 —
              "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/ \
              serviceaccount/token)" https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster. \
              local/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/k97/deployments;
              sleep 10; done']
  • The service account referenced by name used for communicating with the Kubernetes API通过名称引用的、用于与 Kubernetes API 通信的 Service Account
  • Performs an API call to retrieve the list of Pods in the namespace k97执行 API 调用以获取命名空间 k97 中的 Pod 列表
  • Performs an API call to retrieve the list of Deployments in the namespace k97执行 API 调用以获取命名空间 k97 中的 Deployment 列表

Create the objects from the YAML manifest with the following command:

使用下面的命令从 YAML manifest 创建对象：

$ kubectl apply -f setup.yaml
namespace/k97 created
serviceaccount/sa-api created
pod/list-objects created

Verifying the default permissions验证默认权限

The Pod named list-objects makes a call to the API server to retrieve the list of Pods and Deployments in dedicated containers. The container pods performs the call to list Pods. The container deployments sends a request to the API server to list Deployments.

名为 list-objects 的 Pod 在专门的容器中调用 API server，分别获取 Pod 列表和 Deployment 列表。容器 pods 执行列出 Pod 的调用；容器 deployments 向 API server 发送列出 Deployment 的请求。

As explained in the Kubernetes documentation, the default RBAC policies do not grant any permissions to service accounts outside of the kube-system namespace. The logs of the containers pods and deployments return an error message indicating that the service account sa-api is not authorized to list the resources:

如 Kubernetes 文档所述，默认 RBAC 策略不会向 kube-system 命名空间之外的 Service Account 授予任何权限。容器 pods 和 deployments 的日志会返回错误消息，指出 Service Account sa-api 未被授权列出这些资源：

$ kubectl logs list-objects -c pods -n k97
{
  "kind": "Status",
  "apiVersion": "v1",
  "metadata": {},
  "status": "Failure",
  "message": "pods is forbidden: User \"system:serviceaccount:k97:sa-api\" \
              cannot list resource \"pods\" in API group \"\" in the \
              namespace \"k97\"",
  "reason": "Forbidden",
  "details": {
    "kind": "pods"
  },
  "code": 403
}
$ kubectl logs list-objects -c deployments -n k97
{
  "kind": "Status",
  "apiVersion": "v1",
— PDF p.95 —
  "metadata": {},
  "status": "Failure",
  "message": "deployments.apps is forbidden: User \
              \"system:serviceaccount:k97:sa-api\" cannot list resource \
              \"deployments\" in API group \"apps\" in the namespace \
              \"k97\"",
  "reason": "Forbidden",
  "details": {
    "group": "apps",
    "kind": "deployments"
  },
  "code": 403
}

Next up, we’ll stand up a Role and RoleBinding object with the required API permissions to perform the necessary calls.

接下来，我们将搭建一个 Role 和一个 RoleBinding 对象，赋予执行必要调用所需的 API 权限。

Creating the Role创建 Role

Start by defining the Role named list-pods-role shown in Example 6-9 in the file role.yaml. The set of the rules adds only the Pod resource and the verb list.

首先在文件 role.yaml 中定义例 6-9 所示、名为 list-pods-role 的 Role。规则集只添加了 Pod 资源和动词 list。

Example 6-9. YAML manifest for a Role that allows listing Pods

例 6-9. 允许列出 Pod 的 Role 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: list-pods-role
  namespace: k97
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["list"]

Create the object by pointing to its corresponding YAML manifest file:

通过指向对应的 YAML manifest 文件来创建对象：

$ kubectl apply -f role.yaml
role.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/list-pods-role created

Creating the RoleBinding创建 RoleBinding

Example 6-10 defines the YAML manifest for the RoleBinding in the file rolebinding.yaml. The RoleBinding maps the Role list-pods-role to the service account named sa-pod-api and applies it only to the namespace k97.

例 6-10 在文件 rolebinding.yaml 中定义了该 RoleBinding 的 YAML manifest。该 RoleBinding 把 Role list-pods-role 映射到名为 sa-pod-api 的 Service Account，且只作用于命名空间 k97。

Example 6-10. YAML manifest for a RoleBinding attached to a service account

例 6-10. 挂载到 Service Account 的 RoleBinding 的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: serviceaccount-pod-rolebinding
  namespace: k97
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: sa-api
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: list-pods-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
— PDF p.96 —

Create both RoleBinding objects using the apply command:

使用 apply 命令创建 RoleBinding 对象：

$ kubectl apply -f rolebinding.yaml
rolebinding.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/serviceaccount-pod-rolebinding created

Verifying the granted permissions验证已授予的权限

With the granted list permissions, the service account can now properly retrieve all the Pods in the k97 namespace. The curl command in the pods container succeeds, as shown in the following output:

有了被授予的 list 权限后，该 Service Account 现在可以正确获取 k97 命名空间中的所有 Pod。pods 容器中的 curl 命令执行成功，如下输出所示：

$ kubectl logs list-objects -c pods -n k97
{
  "kind": "PodList",
  "apiVersion": "v1",
  "metadata": {
    "resourceVersion": "628"
  },
  "items": [
      {
        "metadata": {
          "name": "list-objects",
          "namespace": "k97",
          ...
      }
  ]
}

We did not grant any permissions to the service account for other resources. Listing the Deployments in the k97 namespace still fails. The following output shows the response from the curl command in the deployments namespace:

我们没有为该 Service Account 授予其他资源的任何权限。在 k97 命名空间中列出 Deployment 仍然失败。下面的输出展示了 deployments 容器中 curl 命令的响应：

$ kubectl logs list-objects -c deployments -n k97
{
  "kind": "Status",
  "apiVersion": "v1",
  "metadata": {},
  "status": "Failure",
  "message": "deployments.apps is forbidden: User \
              \"system:serviceaccount:k97:sa-api\" cannot list resource \
              \"deployments\" in API group \"apps\" in the namespace \"k97\"",
— PDF p.97 —
  "reason": "Forbidden",
  "details": {
    "group": "apps",
    "kind": "deployments"
  },
  "code": 403
}

Feel free to modify the Role object to allow listing Deployment objects as well.

你可以随意修改 Role 对象，使其同时允许列出 Deployment 对象。

Admission Control准入控制

The last phase of processing a request to the API server is admission control. Admission control is implemented by admission controllers. An admission controller provides a webhook to approve, deny, or mutate a request before it takes effect.

处理 API server 请求的最后一个阶段是准入控制。准入控制由准入控制器（admission controller）实现。准入控制器提供一个 webhook，在请求生效之前对其进行批准、拒绝或修改（mutate）。

Admission controllers can be registered with the configuration of the API server. By default, the configuration file can be found at /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml. It is the cluster administrator’s job to manage the API server configuration. The following command-line invocation of the API server enables the admission control plug-ins named NamespaceLifecycle, PodSecurity, and LimitRanger:

准入控制器可以通过 API server 的配置进行注册。默认情况下，配置文件位于 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml。管理 API server 配置是集群管理员的工作。下面对 API server 的命令行调用启用了名为 NamespaceLifecycle、PodSecurity 和 LimitRanger 的准入控制插件：

$ kube-apiserver --enable-admission-plugins=NamespaceLifecycle,PodSecurity,\
  LimitRanger

Developers will inadvertently use admission control plug-ins that have been configured by the administrator. Two examples are the LimitRanger and the ResourceQuota, which I’ll discuss in “Working with Limit Ranges” on page 173 and “Working with Resource Quotas” on page 170.

开发者会在不知不觉中使用管理员配置好的准入控制插件。两个例子是 LimitRanger 和 ResourceQuota，我将在第 173 页“Working with Limit Ranges”和第 170 页“Working with Resource Quotas”中讨论。

Summary本章小结

The API server processes requests to the Kubernetes API. Every request has to go through three phases: authentication, authorization, and admission control. Every phase can prevent further processing. For example, if the credentials sent with the request cannot be authenticated, then the request will be dropped.

API server 处理对 Kubernetes API 的请求。每个请求都必须经过三个阶段：认证、授权和准入控制。每个阶段都可以阻止请求继续处理。例如，如果随请求发送的凭证无法通过认证，该请求就会被丢弃。

We looked at examples of all phases. The authentication phase covered kubectl as the client making a call to the Kubernetes API. The kubeconfig file serves as configuration source for named clusters, users, and their credentials. In Kubernetes, authorization is handled by RBAC. We learned the Kubernetes primitives that let you configure permissions for API resources tied to one or many subjects.

我们查看了所有阶段的示例。认证阶段以 kubectl 作为调用 Kubernetes API 的客户端。kubeconfig 文件作为命名集群、用户及其凭证的配置来源。在 Kubernetes 中，授权由 RBAC 处理。我们学习了让你为绑定到一个或多个主体的 API 资源配置权限的 Kubernetes 原语。

Finally, we briefly examined the purpose of admission control and listed some plug-ins that act as controllers for validating or mutating a request to the Kubernetes API.

最后，我们简要考察了准入控制的目的，并列出了一些充当控制器、用于校验或修改对 Kubernetes API 请求的插件。

— PDF p.98 —

Exam Essentials考试要点

Practice interacting with the Kubernetes API练习与 Kubernetes API 交互

This chapter demonstrated some ways to communicate with the Kubernetes API. We performed API requests by switching to a user context and with the help of a RESTful API call using curl. Explore the Kubernetes API and its endpoints on your own for broader exposure.

本章演示了与 Kubernetes API 通信的一些方式。我们通过切换到用户 context，并借助 curl 发起 RESTful API 调用来执行 API 请求。请自行探索 Kubernetes API 及其端点，以获得更广泛的接触。

Understand the implications of defining RBAC rules for users and service accounts理解为用户和 Service Account 定义 RBAC 规则的影响

Anonymous user requests to the Kubernetes API will not allow any substantial operations. For requests coming from a user or a service account, you will need to carefully analyze permissions granted to the subject. Learn the ins and outs of defining RBAC rules by creating the relevant objects to control permissions. Service accounts automount a token when used in a Pod. Expose the token as a volume only if you are intending to make API calls from the Pod.

匿名用户对 Kubernetes API 的请求不允许执行任何实质性操作。对于来自用户或 Service Account 的请求，你需要仔细分析授予该主体的权限。通过创建相关对象来控制权限，从而掌握定义 RBAC 规则的方方面面。Service Account 在 Pod 中使用时会自动挂载令牌。只有当你打算从 Pod 发起 API 调用时，才把该令牌作为 volume 暴露。

Be aware of the purpose of admission control了解准入控制的目的

The API server comes with preconfigured admission control plug-ins that support the functionality of Kubernetes primitives like LimitRange. For the exam, you will not have to have a deep understanding of enabling or configuring admission control plug-ins.

API server 自带预配置的准入控制插件，用于支持 LimitRange 等 Kubernetes 原语的功能。考试不要求你深入理解如何启用或配置准入控制插件。
